Our drinks menu, in motion

Our Molee interiors

Warm light, wooden tables and a window seat with your name on it.

A warm corner, brewed with care.

Molee started with one idea: coffee should slow your day down, not speed it up. We roast in small batches, pour every cup by hand and keep the lights low and the seats comfortable.

Come for the flat white. Stay for the window seat, the rain on the glass and the croissant still warm from the oven.
